data.name: IntroMessageGroupBox.ToolTip
data.value: The text displayed in the message bar after entering the map. Maximum length is 76. Check the conversations window for more information on text messages. Press Escape to lose focus of this control.

data.name: WorldmapDescriptionGroupBox.ToolTip
data.value: The text displayed when looking at this map's location on the worldmap. Up to four lines long, with the first line having a length of up to 45 characters, and the rest of up to 60. Press Escape to lose focus of this control.

data.name: SetCellPropertyDropdownList.ToolTip
data.value: Editing Filter When editing cells, ony filtered properties are affected. Edting can be done by: - Changing cell properties while Active Mode is toggled on - Painting/filling with the chosen cell properties - Pasting copied cells from the clipboard
